title.command: t=""; id=""; s=""; p=""; pfx=""; eval "$(jq -r '@sh "t=\(.conversation_title // "") id=\(.conversation_id // "") s=\(.agent_state // "idle") p=\(.tool_confirmation_pending // false)"')"; if [ -z "$t" ] && [ -n "$id" ] && [ -r "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/annotations/$id.pbtxt" ]; then t=$(jq -Rr 'capture("title:\\s*(?<q>\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\")").q | fromjson' "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/annotations/$id.pbtxt" 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ "$p" = true ] || [ "$s" = reviewing ] || [ "$s" = authenticating ]; then pfx="● "; elif [ "$s" = working ] || [ "$s" = tool_use ] || [ "$s" = initializing ] || [ "$s" = merging ]; then set -- ⠋ ⠙ ⠹ ⠸ ⠼ ⠴ ⠦ ⠧ ⠇ ⠏; shift $(( ($(date +%s%3N) / 300) % 10 )); pfx="$1 "; fi; printf '%s%s\n' "$pfx" "${t:-agy}"
